contentGaps: Top results are opinion pieces and forums with no concrete weight-and-load numbers; give weights and capacities against a mirrorless body plus 24-70mm and a full-frame body plus 70-200mm f/2.8
Almost none explain how camera droop at lock-off ruins a precisely aligned horizon, or how to counter it (friction knob, tension setting, nudging past the mark)
Few address packed size and added height for a daypack or carry-on
Leveling base or panning clamp is rarely discussed as the way to get 3-way precision from a ball head
Portrait-orientation handling on a pan-tilt head (L-bracket vs tilt-only handles) is skipped
Arca-Swiss compatibility and clamp type differences are missing
Speed in wind, cold and glove use at sunrise is not covered
The video question (ball head vs fluid head) is barely answered
Few give a clear choose X if / choose Y if verdict with a hybrid option
